holdout_card.fact_statement: A grand coalition was formed following the 2025 German federal election.
holdout_card.source_span: Because the CDU/CSU and SPD were always the strongest parties until this election, a coalition of the two is conventionally known as a "grand coalition"

qa_variants.question: What type of government coalition was formed following the 2025 German federal election?
qa_variants.source_span: Because the CDU/CSU and SPD were always the strongest parties until this election, a coalition of the two is conventionally known as a "grand coalition"
